text:
[IRET.25.5.3] The rate-allow state is maintained
per-engine.  The gate key is the rule name followed by
the activation key ([LCDB.3.3.3], [IRET.10.4]), compared with the identity
RLOW.4.6.2.1 states: component by component, representation and value, exact
and whole. libds must not render a key lossily — no rounding of a `Float`, no
truncation of a component or of the whole, no separator a component can
contain — and holds no key-length limit of its own.

---

idris.name: Rlow_4_6_2_1__word
idris.note: libds's word codec, `rk_feed_u64`'s eight little-endian bytes of a 64-bit count and a reader for them, as a parameter taken at its contract rather than modelled byte by byte.

idris.name: Rlow_4_6_2_1__word_ok
idris.note: The codec's contract -- a word written in front of anything reads back as that word and the rest -- which eight little-endian bytes have for every value a uint64 holds.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__bool_of
idris.note: A Bool's word read back: libds writes 1 or 0 (`rk_walk`, rete/adapters.c).

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__bytes_rt
idris.note: 'No truncation of a component, no separator a component can contain': a length-prefixed component -- a String, Bytes or Json -- reads back whole from in front of any tail, whatever bytes it holds and however long it is.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__bytes_then
idris.note: A length-prefixed component read back, `rk_feed_bytes` inverted: the word says how many bytes are the component's.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__cons_of
idris.note: A component read in front of the components read after it.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__decode
idris.note: The stored key read back: the count, then that many components, nothing left over. libds compares keys in place (`rk_walk` into a comparing sink) and has no reader; this one exists because a reader that inverts the writer is what makes the writer injective.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__decode_encode
idris.note: The stored key reads back as the key, on every key, under every codec with the contract.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__encode
idris.note: THE KEY AS libds STORES IT, transcribed from `rk_walk` (rete/adapters.c): the component count, then per component a tag byte for its representation and a fixed-width word, or a length word and the bytes. The clause's 'compared with the identity RLOW.4.6.2.1 states' is what `rlow_4_6_2_1__encode_injective` establishes of it.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__encode_injective
idris.note: libds DOES NOT RENDER A KEY LOSSILY: two keys stored as one byte string are one key under RLOW.4.6.2.1's identity, for every pair of keys. No rounding (a Float is its bits), no truncation and no in-band separator (the count, the tag bytes and the length words make the frame prefix-free), no key-length limit (the theorem is for every length). Under the one hypothesis that the word codec has its contract, which eight little-endian bytes do.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__field_of
idris.note: One component read back: the tag byte decides the shape, the word the value or the length.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__field_rt
idris.note: A component written reads back, for every component of every representation and every tail.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__field_to
idris.note: One component's bytes, `rk_walk`'s arm for its kind: the tag (`RK_NULL` .. `RK_RATIO`), then a word or a length word and the bytes.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__fields_of
idris.note: So many components read back, in order.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__fields_rt
idris.note: The components written read back, as many as were written.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__fields_to
idris.note: The components' bytes in the key's order.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__ratio_of
idris.note: A Ratio's second word read back after its first.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__ratio_rt
idris.note: A Ratio's two words read back.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__whole_of
idris.note: The components read back are the key when nothing is left over.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__word_rt
idris.note: A scalar component -- an Int, a Time's count, a Float's bits, a Bool, a fact id -- reads back from in front of any tail.

idris.name: rlow_4_6_2_1__word_then
idris.note: A scalar component read back: one word, under the constructor its tag named.
